Comments (English): [ I'll keep your hands dry ] || ---------------- || -Media Electric Dishwasher 3-Person, MD-32BK (Black). -Ordered: Tuesday evening, February 7, 2023. -Delivered: Wednesday morning, February 8, 2023. Finally, we have a dishwasher. Every day after a long meal, I sigh at the sight of all the dishes I have to wash. It's always been a dream to just use a dishwasher without doing the dishes, and now it's finally here. It seats 3-4 people, making it perfect for our family of four. It might be a bit small for those who wash a lot of dishes, but we didn't want a huge dishwasher, so it's perfect. It's also a great size for those living alone. This dishwasher is convenient because it's installation-free. Instead of having to connect to a water supply, you simply fill it with 5 liters of water before use. When water is needed, a faucet-shaped indicator will appear. Once the 5 liters are filled, a beeping sound will sound and the faucet will disappear. That means you can stop pouring water. It was convenient because it automatically notified me and made a sound. I bought a dishwasher-specific detergent from Coupang, and it seemed to work perfectly. I used it after finishing dinner and loading all the dishes I needed to wash, and it cleaned them really well. The basic mode took 1 hour and 4 minutes, and as expected, it was cleaner and shinier than when I did it by hand, which was very satisfying. They say using a dishwasher can change your quality of life, and it's true. It's so convenient, and the black color is sleek and pretty. And the noise level was almost nonexistent in my opinion. It wasn't bothersome at all. It was also great for water draining. I highly recommend this product to anyone living alone or looking for a dishwasher that's not too big or too small. Stop getting your hands dirty and let the dishwasher do the work! This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

A woman could do it alone, but it's so heavy that I think a man might find it a bit easier. I rearranged it as soon as I got home. It takes up quite a bit of space under my studio sink. In a small house, it definitely has a presence. It's big, but small? That's the feeling. (With no cooking space, I'm at a loss for what to do.) I had no choice but to install it between the sink and the highlighter. The orange color doesn't look that bad. I think the color makes it look even bigger. The drain hose is longer than I thought and it's quite tangled. I rolled it up and put it away so it's not visible, but it's fine for now. After dinner and lunch the night before, I washed it according to the instructions in the dishwasher manual and set it to standard. It's perfect because it has a cutlery holder and a small second-tier section. I haven't used the milk bottle holder yet, but I'll get to it someday. (Number of dishes that went in: 2 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 cups, 2 tumblers, 2 espresso cups, 2 tumbler lids, 1 stainless steel plate, 1 silicone rice scoop, several spoons, rice spatula). Large plates and bowls take up quite a bit of space, so you can't put in many, which is a shame. And you have to put in the chopsticks carefully! They might get caught on the wings on top and not spin, so put them in and spin them. I didn't know the drying function was running, so I opened the door as soon as it was over. It wasn't working, hahahaha. And I touched it right away. There was a sign on the door saying, "Do not touch!" My impatient personality is showing here. (I should have read the manual carefully.) Still, there wasn't as much moisture as I thought. The only thing is that water collected in the grooves of the water cup, so you'll have to tilt it, but it's okay. The stainless steel plate didn't clean well to begin with. There were some marks? (Is it because of the detergent? Or the machine?). I used Coupang's Tamsa powder detergent, which I bought for about 8,000 won per kilogram. (They said it didn't leave water stains, but it was cheap, so I guess it's okay.) The noise level isn't that bad, but it's about the same as a washing machine running. It would be annoying if you run it late at night, right? It's probably best to run it in the morning before you leave. There are two places to add water, the top and the bottom. The bottom requires a separate tap connection, so I skipped it. You can pour water directly into the top or into the drip tray. Whichever is more convenient for you. And as all the reviews say, be sure to turn it on and add water! Everyone reported getting an error message, but mine was a good product. It washed the dishes cleanly without any reaction. It holds 5 liters of water, about a full bottle and a half. It was like I could just wash the dishes right away. Ha. After eating, I find it so annoying that I just keep piling things up. The dishwasher keeps popping up and catching my eye, and I want to use one myself. I'm grateful for the opportunity to try it out, and it enriches my life :-). Overall: It sterilizes at high temperatures. It cleans grease well (5 stars, the most satisfying!). It saves water. Since it's for three people, I need less detergent than I thought. This was a single-use product, and I'll write another review after multiple uses! To be continued 20,000 total... Second review. After using it for about a month. Completely satisfied! I didn't know this and spun the tumbler around and it stained it. Please note that it's not easy to remove. If you're good at Tetris, it can easily make two meals! Sentence (English): This was a replacement machine for an 8 yr.
Comments (English): [ This was a replacement machine for an 8 yr. old.  ] || ---------------- || This was a replacement machine for an 8 yr. old dishwasher. Let me start by saying EVERY MACHINE built TODAY is "Energy Efficient" which translates to smaller interior. The reason I gave it 2 stars: For your dishes to come out dry it is recommended that a Rinse Aid be used along with the wash cycle. Why must I use Rinse Aid for drying dishes,this should be automatic with the wash cycle! The interior top rack is nice: plenty of room for glasses,small dishes,plates,etc. Love the slots for lids and peaks in shelf so glasses do not slide around! The wash cycles are very quiet and I love the Display Panel! Lower rack is very awkward to load. It takes some maneuvering. Slots for plates are angled sharply in one direction and very close together. Too many large slots and not enough medium. All the slots on bottom rack are like a Maze,not very "energy efficient". I did a lot of research before buying a dishwasher and I thought this was the best option for me. In hindsight the biggest negative for me is the wet dishes after EVERY CYCLE! If you are like me and don't like to use a lot of products on your dishes this is something to consider when thinking about purchasing!

Comments (English): [ Lemon vs Unlucky? You decide. ] || ---------------- || The good: - It runs fine. Heavier coated dishes, or pre-rinsed. Stuff gets clean, even dishes that were caked on and left for longer than they should have been, scorched soup/rice pots, cups, bowls, cutlery, etc. - It's a reasonable volume. Control panel now suspected. They order it in, tech returns to install it. Dishwasher now works fully again. Yay. Unfortunately the part costs alone came out to be almost 50% of what I paid for the dishwasher initially. Only 2 years in. Your choice. If I got unlucky, and you're not seeing many reviews along the lines of my situation. you might be safe with this model, and happy with it. I definitely was. until it croaked. Good luck.

Comments (English): [ Functions well, pretty… but arrived w/ some damage ] || ---------------- || So far, so ok. I run the unit three times and it seems to work quite well… similar to the old unit I replaced. My only issue with it is that the control panel arrived scuffed up. My concern is that now that the thick plastic protective layer above the buttons has been compromised, that it might ultimately lead to the functionality being compromised at some point down the line as it'll be accumulating regular wear from pressing buttons under the scuffs regularly. I'm torn between living with a scuffed control panel for what I hope to be at least a decade… or initiating a return and dealing with another delivery and install and haul away - I've actually had two Samsung microwaves that each had issues and have needed return. I feel like my kitchen is a revolving door for Samsung over the last month+. Best Buy has been very good with it all, no pushback… very understanding and strive to make each situation right. Oh… the unit is beautiful! I love the black stainless. I've got the microwave and range, both match. So far I'm pleased with the functionality of each items. Can't wait for my fridge to arrive in a couple of weeks! Oh the drying is typical. I've never had cups on the top rack come out completely dry, even in my last unit. It dries the lower rack great and I like how the door pops open after the dry cycle is completed!

Sentence (English): Overall, happy with DW.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well ] || ---------------- || Overall, happy with DW. PROS: It cleans well, not super loud, easy to move, decent cleaning options. Comparing it to my previous built-in, the functionality is pretty similar. Hose & power cord lengths are good. I haven't had any issues getting them out of or back into the DW. CONS: HUGE design flaw with the hidden control panel. GE really needs to redo. Once door is closed, you are not able to see the time left without opening the door or to cancel cycle you must open the door (opening the door is required for everything). Wow…someone missed the mark there. The sanitize option is looong compared to my previous built-in. I no longer use because the DW cleans just fine on regular autosense setting. Tub is a bit small & the racks are configured a little weird so putting dishes in takes some creativity. The silverware basket is HORRIBLE. The individual slots are very tiny so some things won't fit through the basket topper. The toppers are removable & the basket is decent sized. However, another design flaw is basket placement. It will only sit in one corner & there is nothing to hold it in place so it does shift. Very odd. I have no complaints about the condensation dry. It works as GE says if you give it some time. I use rinse aid & let the DW sit for a few minutes once it's done. I open the door just a crack to let some moisture escape & leave it that way for at least 15 minutes. I then partially open the door to let the rest of the moisture & heat out & after another 15-20 minutes, the dishes are 95-99% dry…even plastics. My previous built-in couldn't do any better. The price is a bit steep IMO, but as long as it continues to work well it's money well spent.

CONS: HUGE design flaw with the hidden control panel. GE really needs to redo. Once door is closed, you are not able to see the time left without opening the door or to cancel cycle you must open the door (opening the door is required for everything). Wow…someone missed the mark there. The sanitize option is looong compared to my previous built-in. I no longer use because the DW cleans just fine on regular autosense setting. Tub is a bit small & the racks are configured a little weird so putting dishes in takes some creativity. The silverware basket is HORRIBLE. The individual slots are very tiny so some things won't fit through the basket topper. The toppers are removable & the basket is decent sized. However, another design flaw is basket placement. It will only sit in one corner & there is nothing to hold it in place so it does shift. Very odd. I have no complaints about the condensation dry. It works as GE says if you give it some time. I use rinse aid & let the DW sit for a few minutes once it's done. I open the door just a crack to let some moisture escape & leave it that way for at least 15 minutes. I then partially open the door to let the rest of the moisture & heat out & after another 15-20 minutes, the dishes are 95-99% dry…even plastics. My previous built-in couldn't do any better. The price is a bit steep IMO, but as long as it continues to work well it's money well spent.

Sentence (English): I bought about a month ago and we are very satisfied with how it's been working.
Comments (English): [ Kitchen Aid Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought about a month ago and we are very satisfied with how it's been working. It is very quiet which is nice and it gets the dishes consistently very clean. Nice looking stainless door goes well with the rest of our kitchen appliances. Controls are simple and easy to understand. Definitely an upgrade in performance vs over 24 year old Kenmore which was getting tired. That said you can tell the unit is a bit flimsier compared to the vintage units and the old unit seemed to dry a bit better. The foam insulation comes uncovered and loosely attached and wants to peal away from the unit as you tuck it under the counter, nothing to hold it so I taped up with HVAC tape to hold it in place. Also the door and mechanism is not as robust as older units though works fine. I wouldn't leave the door laying fully open for concern of somebody accidentally mashing it to the floor. Installation was a bit difficult since on the new unit, the inner utilities on the left side are exactly flush (aux. pump unit) with the outer width dimension giving no leeway to snug up against the cabinet work on the left side. That left a gap I had to hide the hinge and frame work with a strip of black foam tucked in there. Looks ok. Rear of the unit was the same inching forward the unit vs optimal. Very little room for the drain tube to flex between the cabinets. That said it's working fine, looks good and with we have no complaints though I dread the thought of ever having to pull the unit out for any reason. Recommend carefully measuring your cabinet requirements beyond just the height and width of the facing.

Comments (English): [ A fairly usable dishwasher ] || ---------------- || In today's busy world, washing dishes after meals can be a hassle, so I bought a new dishwasher, which is currently trending. My first impression was the size of the box, but it arrived carefully packaged to protect the contents. My first impression was that it was really cute and well-designed. Comments (English): [ Nice! ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher to replace an older Bosch dishwasher that failed after 14 years. I will say though that this KitchenAid dishwasher does clean the dishes nicely but, if it wasn't brand new we would take it out & replace it with a Bosch!

Sentence (English): We replaced our Kenmore Elite dishwasher with a Bosch dishwasher, upon the recommendation of a friend, and we've regretted that decision since day 1!
Comments (English): [ Bosch Dishwashers Are Worthless Crap! ] || ---------------- || We replaced our Kenmore Elite dishwasher with a Bosch dishwasher, upon the recommendation of a friend, and we've regretted that decision since day 1! The Bosch dishwasher comes nowhere near close to cleaning as well as our Kenmore Elite did. 90% of the loads in the Bosch will have 2 or more items with something still on them and we have to wash again. More often than not, the remaining sauce bits will come off by just spraying down with hot water. The Bosch dishwasher can't even get its door clean! If anything drops onto the door while loading the dishwasher, it will still be there after the wash cycles end. If you love rewashing dishes and having to clean the door after evry single load, then this is the dishwasher for you! We never had any of these issues with our Kenmore Elite dishwasher. We've thoroughly regretted purchasing the Bosch dishwasher. If it wasn't just over a year old, and didn't cost as much as it did, I'd throw it onto the curb and get a new dishwasher - definitely not a Bosch!

Sentence (English): The third rack is the best thing I didn't know I needed.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher I've ever owned ] || ---------------- || The third rack is the best thing I didn't know I needed. Glasses that always had water pooled on them now get to lay gently at an angle in the third upper rack and enjoy their wash. This also dries dishes really well. I used to always have a dish towel on hand when I unloaded my Whirlpool since every dish seemed to have water on it. I no longer have to strategize which rack I open first for fear that the upper racks would "rain down" on the lower racks. This one even gets nearly every plastic item completely dry. My glasses are crystal clear with no film or water spots (and we have really hard water). We chose this one mostly due to it's low DB as it "lives" with us in our open family space. It's very quiet. You can tell it's running but not noisy at all when we watch TV at night. It was a little pricier than I had originally wanted to pay, but I'm a believer in spending the extra $200 to get the features you really want with things you use on a daily basis. We installed it ourselves and it took my engineer, mechanically inclined husband about 2 hours total. Side note: We spent money on a Bosch at our old house that didn't have a heating element. We were "sold" on the steam drying option. I never did like that thing. It always had a little bit of a funny smell and my dishes never felt completely dry. I'd choose this one over my old expensive Bosch.

Sentence (English): I would love to give this dishwasher 5/5 stars, but there are just a couple things that drop it just a little.
Comments (English): [ Incredibly quiet, effective dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I would love to give this dishwasher 5/5 stars, but there are just a couple things that drop it just a little. Let me preface by saying I was in LOVE with my 10+ year old Bosch 300 dishwasher, and only bought a new one because the old one flooded ONE time (maybe it was a one-time deal, but with the cost of replacing kitchen flooring if another flood happened when we weren't home, we felt we had no choice). So I was very used to the feel of the old one which might contribute to my liking the new one less. The new Bosch 800 series cleans the dishes wonderfully, and is SUPREMELY quiet. If noise is the #1 factor in your choice, definitely BUY this one. You can stand next to it and not know if it is on. The only things I don't like is that the controls on the door are hard to press and the door itself is difficult to close. I would've liked actual buttons as opposed to the flat surface "buttons" there now. I still haven't figured out how to load the dishwasher to maximize how many dishes I can do at once, which is a concern as the wash time for automatic settings is a significant 2:39. Those small issues being said, if this dishwasher has the current cleaning power and the longevity of my last model, I will be very satisfied. Possibly, after a few years, I will even grow to love it as much as my last one!

Let me preface by saying I was in LOVE with my 10+ year old Bosch 300 dishwasher, and only bought a new one because the old one flooded ONE time (maybe it was a one-time deal, but with the cost of replacing kitchen flooring if another flood happened when we weren't home, we felt we had no choice). So I was very used to the feel of the old one which might contribute to my liking the new one less. The new Bosch 800 series cleans the dishes wonderfully, and is SUPREMELY quiet. If noise is the #1 factor in your choice, definitely BUY this one. You can stand next to it and not know if it is on. The only things I don't like is that the controls on the door are hard to press and the door itself is difficult to close. I would've liked actual buttons as opposed to the flat surface "buttons" there now. I still haven't figured out how to load the dishwasher to maximize how many dishes I can do at once, which is a concern as the wash time for automatic settings is a significant 2:39. Those small issues being said, if this dishwasher has the current cleaning power and the longevity of my last model, I will be very satisfied. Possibly, after a few years, I will even grow to love it as much as my last one!

Comments (English): [ Not all that I hoped for ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher works good, but, I am disappointed with the top two racks. The top rack does not have room to place anything but silverware in it. It also isn't angled enough to place things like storage container lids in it because they hold water. The middle rack also doesn't have enough angle to prevent water from pooling in coffee cups and small bowls. I may remove the top rack so that I can place larger items in the second rack such as storage containers. When I moved the second rack down to accommodate lager items, the water arm hit my plates in the lower rack. I never had this happen with my prior dishwasher. I changed brands so that all of my appliance handles matched. I do like the water jets under the silverware basket and the bottle washer jets. When the white, finished light goes on, a fan still runs to dry the dishes. I wait until I no longer hear the fan running to open the door. Seems like the light should go on after the fan stops running.

Sentence (English): We got the device to replace a defective Neff device.
Comments (English): [ Top device, very economical ] || ---------------- || We got the device to replace a defective Neff device. The dishwasher is very spacious because there is a top compartment for cutlery. This eliminates the cutlery basket. The machine cleans excellently and is very quiet. The flush time is displayed at the bottom of the floor. The ECO level in particular is great: 1.6 kW and 9 liters of water are very good. Handwashing requires more energy. A connection via Bluetooth and thus operation via an app is possible, but only works in half of the cases. The program is then selected and started manually on the machine. If an online connection works, the dishwashing assistant is very funny: it guides you through a menu to select the program. We can only recommend the dishwasher. Oh yes: when setting up the app you can give the machine a name. Our name is Minna.
Comments (Original): [ Top-Gerät, sehr sparsam ] || ---------------- || Wir haben das Gerät als Ersatz für ein defektes Neff-Gerät geholt. Die Spülmaschine ist sehr geräumig, da ein Oberfach für Besteck da ist. Dadurch fällt der Besteckkorb weg. Die Maschine reinigt hervorragend und ist sehr leise. Die Spülzeit wird unten am Fußboden angezeigt. Insbesondere die ECO-Stufe ist klasse: 1,6 kW und 9 l Wasser sind sehr gut. Handspülen ist energieaufwändiger. Eine Verbindung per Bluetooth und damit Bedienung per App ist möglich, klappt aber nur in der Hälfte der Fälle. Dann wird eben manuell an der Maschine das Programm gewählt und gestartet. Wenn eine Online-Verbindung funktioniert, ist der Spül-Assistent ganz neckisch: mit ihm wird man durch ein Menü zur Programmauswahl geführt. Wir können die Spülmaschine nur empfehlen.Ach ja: bei Einrichten der App kann man der Maschine einen Namen geben. Unsere heißt Minna....

So through it all it will end up being 3 months to get the dishwasher replaced at a minimum as I don't know how long I will have to wait until I am able to get the one I reorder.

Sentence (English): I have owned this dishwasher for 6 months.
Comments (English): [ Repair one month in that was a pretty big hassle. ] || ---------------- || I have owned this dishwasher for 6 months. Things are working fine now. but within one month of owning it, there was no steam (heat for drying) when we opened the door after the cycle was finished and we were getting multiple error codes. I called LG and spoke to someone who, after minutes of flipping through a binder for answers, told me that I must have an electrician out to ensure everything was fine electricity wise before they would proceed with sending out a repairman. Not ever have I been told this before on any appliance issue. I was frustrated and asked my husband to call and see what response he gets. This time we did get approval for a repairman who came out (with no parts) and, thus, is a two trip repair separated by about two weeks. The appointment making was odd. We were told both for the approval for the initial repair and for the follow-up (once the part was given time to arrive) that we would be contacted by another company to make the appointments. That didn't happen either time and WE were the ones having to contact the repair facilitating company to get an appointment made. Most of this was done on an app and sort of left you wondering whether someone was actually coming or not. Not sure if all of this is where we are due to the pandemic or if this is where we are in new times. My point is. boy did we have to work hard to get our dishwasher repaired one month into owning it. This was my very first LG product of any kind. Not sure I will be doing this again. Of course, it was a computer issue. Thinking the less computerized appliances are better. As for the product now that it is working. it does clean well. The only other negative I can say is, I do wish the prongs were better placed on the bottom basket. Seems like I had more or better placed prongs on my last dishwasher. I do like the fold down prongs that allow you to put bigger items in without putting stress on the prongs.

Sentence (English): I bought this washer 6 months ago because it had everything I wanted or so I thought.
Comments (English): [ Quiet with all the bells & whistles, But…. ] || ---------------- || I bought this washer 6 months ago because it had everything I wanted or so I thought. It's got that extra 3rd top rack for those pesky, awkward utensils. It's got 4 bottle washers that I'll be using for the first time today. The racks are adjustable as are the tines in the bottom rack. And it's super quiet. But….It doesn't have a rinse & hold cycle. If you're a small family it may take a day or so to get a load worth washing. Who wants their dishes with stuck on food to sit in a dark, closed space? So, hand rinsing is required. The top control panel is annoying because inevitably when you open the door to load your dishes your leg will engage the panel. It's turns off, but still. And if you want to get your dishes dry after washing, the dry boost is is essential, but will add 60 minutes to any cycle, so a light or 60 minute cycle automatically becomes 2 hours. Upside, the delay wash has an up to 12 hour option so you can load all day, but you will have to hand rinse. (See above). Last thing, there's no indicator for when your rinse agent is running low. You've got to look & guess. All in all it's a pretty good washer for the money. It gets your dishes clean, quietly & dry.

It's got that extra 3rd top rack for those pesky, awkward utensils. It's got 4 bottle washers that I'll be using for the first time today. The racks are adjustable as are the tines in the bottom rack. And it's super quiet. But….It doesn't have a rinse & hold cycle. If you're a small family it may take a day or so to get a load worth washing. Who wants their dishes with stuck on food to sit in a dark, closed space? So, hand rinsing is required. The top control panel is annoying because inevitably when you open the door to load your dishes your leg will engage the panel. It's turns off, but still. And if you want to get your dishes dry after washing, the dry boost is is essential, but will add 60 minutes to any cycle, so a light or 60 minute cycle automatically becomes 2 hours. Upside, the delay wash has an up to 12 hour option so you can load all day, but you will have to hand rinse. (See above). Last thing, there's no indicator for when your rinse agent is running low. You've got to look & guess. All in all it's a pretty good washer for the money. It gets your dishes clean, quietly & dry.

Sentence (English): I've been using it for a while and am leaving a review.
Comments (English): I've been using it for a while and am leaving a review. First of all, like everyone else, I worried a lot. Should I buy it or not? What if I buy it and don't use it? After using it, I realized that such worries were really stupid worries. If you're worried, don't worry. I liked the strong water flow and the water jets spraying from the top and bottom, so I bought it. The size is perfect for a household of 3, including a baby. And looking at other reviews of this product, there are reviews that say that the part where you fill it with water is difficult and the water splashes a lot. It would be best to pull out a long hose from the sink faucet, but for those who have to use it separately like me. If you can't reach the hose, it's good to use a funnel! If you search Coupang, there's a pickled seafood funnel? There's a funnel with a wide opening. The one I bought has a perfect opening size, so I put it in and pour water. It doesn't splash even if you pour it in a lot! Before, I thought the water would splash on the wallpaper. I was so frustrated because I had to be careful not to let the water run down and touch the power lines, but now I have two water containers, and I can quickly fill the water by pouring one in and the other out~! Very satisfied! ^^ . And I made a mistake while using it. I thought it was finished because I heard the sound of air blowing, so I put in water for the next dish, but it wasn't finished for about 10 minutes. When I drained the remaining water, there was too much water left, so it overflowed out of the machine~ An error code appeared and a sound was made, and even when I turned the power off and on, it was the same. I wondered if I should call for after-sales service. But after I forced the drain and turned the power off and on again with all the water out, it worked again~ I'm writing this in case you make a mistake because you're impatient like me~^^ . And the part where you stand the dishes is too narrow. Since I can lay that part down, I laid it down and stored the dishes, and it fit a lot more and was good for space utilization. If you think it doesn't fit well, try laying down the part where you put the dishes! . Lastly, I use this product almost twice a day. When my hands touch water, they peel and crack, and I am the type of person who cannot wear gloves. So, I used to wash dishes without rubber gloves, and when my hands cracked, they would itch again and I would apply ointment. I repeated this, but now I leave all the dishes in the dishwasher and just quickly wash one large frying pan or pot at a time, so my hands crack a lot less and I love it~^^

Sentence (English): My black Whirlpool portable dishwasher is stylish, does not show up fingerprints much, and does a great job at cleaning my dishes.
Comments (English): [ Cleans dishes, not glassware ] || ---------------- || My black Whirlpool portable dishwasher is stylish, does not show up fingerprints much, and does a great job at cleaning my dishes. There are a few things that could use improvement, though: there seems to be no place designed to hold bowls very well; no place to hold a crock pot liner (folding tines would be good for these this); the utensil basket's sides should be higher to avoid all the forks, knives, etc. leaning over the edge and stopping the door from shutting; it always leaves my glassware with an opaque film on them (only Cascade Platinum Plus gel tabs are able to get them clean); the hose is sometimes impossible to get in or out of the back of the dishwasher (You need to put in the instructions to be careful to make sure that both hoses are next to each other as you pull them out or push them in and not let them tangle on top of each other as you push and pull.); the instructions do not mention how to clean the inside bottom of the dishwasher - there a thin layer of solid grease that accumulates on the plastic strainer, etc. blocking the holes and I don't know how to get that clean without wiping it into the holes; The sides of the two main trays have large openings and many of my smaller dishes, which fit nicely along the edges, only fall through, so have to be placed at less convenient places; I literally need and use a flashlight each time I set and turn on the machine because the controls are not lit up. There is only a lighted dot under the various washing and drying options that lights up. This is not sufficient to allow anyone to read the functions, especially since the options will always be facing away from the window's light, but even my 5 bulb ceiling light above the dishwasher is not enough to allow me to read the function buttons, so I suggest you make the words light up on the function control bar. so I won't have to use a flashlight each and every time I use the dishwasher; and finally, the price is exorbitant and needs to be reduced since it is a simple, basic, plastic dishwasher with no bells and whistles; Though the dishwasher makes audible noise as it washes, it is much more quiet than my previous dishwasher. All these things could be improved. I know that portable dishwashers have very few options but this one was the best one out there when I bought it in early 2022. Overall, I am happy with the pretty good job it has been doing on cleaning the dishes, that it does not have a large handle to get in the way, how good it looks, how easily it glides on the floor which makes it easier to move, and how it does not make as much noise as my former dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I bought this washer 6 months ago because it had everything I wanted or so I thought.
Comments (English): [ Quiet with all the bells & whistles, But…. ] || ---------------- || I bought this washer 6 months ago because it had everything I wanted or so I thought. It's got that extra 3rd top rack for those pesky, awkward utensils. It's got 4 bottle washers that I'll be using for the first time today. The racks are adjustable as are the tines in the bottom rack. And it's super quiet. But…. It doesn't have a rinse & hold cycle. If you're a small family it may take a day or so to get a load worth washing. Who wants their dishes with stuck on food to sit in a dark, closed space? So, hand rinsing is required. The top control panel is annoying because inevitably when you open the door to load your dishes your leg will engage the panel. It's turns off, but still. And if you want to get your dishes dry after washing, the dry boost is is essential, but will add 60 minutes to any cycle, so a light or 60 minute cycle automatically becomes 2 hours. Upside, the delay wash has an up to 12 hour option so you can load all day, but you will have to hand rinse. (See above). Last thing, there's no indicator for when your rinse agent is running low. You've got to look & guess. All in all it's a pretty good washer for the money. It gets your dishes clean, quietly & dry.

Sentence (English): We bought the Bosch because our daughter has one that is a year or two old and it cleans beautifully.
Comments (English): [ READ BEFORE BUYING A BOSCH DISHWASHER ] || ---------------- || We bought the Bosch because our daughter has one that is a year or two old and it cleans beautifully. We learned, however, that Bosch has made significant changes, apparently, since she bought hers.This is a great dishwasher when it comes to getting the dishes clean and it is very quiet, so why the one star rating? I gave it only one star for several reasons. 1. This dishwasher is narrower than our old one and most other dishwashers on the market. When it was installed, there was a noticeable and ugly gap between it and the cabinets. The main part of the dishwasher is narrower than the top panel with the controls and even it was narrower than other dishwashers which exaggerated the gap of the rest of the dishwasher with the cabinets and made it look even uglier. (I went to Best Buy and measured the different dishwasher brands after the install.)2. The interior of the dishwasher is smaller than any standard dishwasher we've ever owned.3. Perhaps the most annoying thing about the Bosch, is the tines are angled, not straight which is a huge challenge when loading dishes, bowls, the coffee pot or any even somewhat larger item. In addition, the tines are very close together making it impossible to load even a small lid for a very small Corning Ware bowl. We used to have stoneware dishes. I sincerely doubt they would fit inside the tines, the space is that narrow. As if that wasn't enough of a challenge, they have different sections where the tines run in opposite directions, i.e. at a right angle to the other section making loading plates and, especially, other items even more impossible than the narrow tines make it already. Conclusion. If you currently use most, or all of the space in your dishwasher to run a load, plan on having to do two loads, not one, to get your dishes done. It's a shame Bosch designed this machine so poorly and made it smaller on the interior and exterior than all other standard size dishwashers as it does a great job of cleaning. For these reasons, I cannot recommend the Bosch.We replaced the Bosch with a KitchenAid with the third rack on top. I am happy to report that the KitchenAid cleans just as well as the Bosch, is just as quiet as the Bosch, fits the space just like other dishwashers without an ugly, large gap and has a very, very large interior and is extremely easy to load and handles large objects and/or odd-shaped dishes very well.

When it was installed, there was a noticeable and ugly gap between it and the cabinets. Perhaps the most annoying thing about the Bosch, is the tines are angled, not straight which is a huge challenge when loading dishes, bowls, the coffee pot or any even somewhat larger item. In addition, the tines are very close together making it impossible to load even a small lid for a very small Corning Ware bowl. We used to have stoneware dishes. I sincerely doubt they would fit inside the tines, the space is that narrow.  As if that wasn't enough of a challenge, they have different sections where the tines run in opposite directions, i.e. at a right angle to the other section making loading plates and, especially, other items even more impossible than the narrow tines make it already. Conclusion. If you currently use most, or all of the space in your dishwasher to run a load, plan on having to do two loads, not one, to get your dishes done. For these reasons, I cannot recommend the Bosch.We replaced the Bosch with a KitchenAid with the third rack on top. I am happy to report that the KitchenAid cleans just as well as the Bosch, is just as quiet as the Bosch, fits the space just like other dishwashers without an ugly, large gap and has a very, very large interior and is extremely easy to load and handles large objects and/or odd-shaped dishes very well.

Sentence (English): I only use it a few times to evaluate it, and it really frees my hands.

It is really free of installation, just pour water into the water injection port, plug in the electricity, throw in the dishwashing block, and press the switch. The washing is very clean, but the premise is that the dishes that have just been eaten should be soaked or rinsed immediately, and then put into the dishwasher, and the dishes should not be too full, and should be placed in the required position to meet these conditions Yes, it can be washed very clean. If the dishes are left for a period of time, when the rice grains stick to the dishes, or the dishes are very oily, the sticky residue cannot be completely washed off. If you are really dissatisfied, you can wash it again, which can almost solve this problem. Anyway, you don't have to wash it yourself. For my family, I don’t need to be too perfect. I can recommend it. It is indeed a good helper for a family of three. At least it frees up time for washing dishes.
Comments (Original): 使用几次才来评价，的确是解放了双手。真正免安装，直接倒水进注水口，插上电，丢进去洗碗块，按开关即可。洗得很干净，但前提是要把刚吃完的碗碟马上泡水或冲洗一下，再放进洗碗机，且碗碟不能放太满，要按要求位置摆放，满足这几个条件了，就能洗很干净了。如果碗碟放置一段时间，米粒黏在碗碟的时候，或油性很重的碗碟，就不能完全洗掉黏渣了，实在不满意，还可以再洗一遍，就差不多可以解决这个问题了，反正不用自己洗就好。对于自己家人用的，不要求太完美的，可以推荐，的确是三口之家的好帮手，至少腾出了洗碗的时间。

Sentence (English): After struggling for at least 5 years, I finally got it.
Comments (English): After struggling for at least 5 years, I finally got it. I’m still on the sidelines. Buy it early, buy it early, and enjoy it early. There are a few reasons why I choose this product: 1. Open the door to dry, the power saving time is short and it’s breathable. As long as you don’t choose quick wash, it’s basically automatic. Just open the door and dry. There was no dishwasher at home before, so I also had to open the cabinet to ventilate; 2. The water pressure is high, and the water pressure of an ordinary bowl is generally enough, but it is necessary to wash the grill pan, the gas stove shelf, and the range hood filter. It needs strong pressure and high water temperature to rinse it off. Buy the one with the highest water pressure within the budget; 3. If the number of sets is large, you can put a few more pots, and you can also wash the cutting board and vegetable basket. For a family of three to eat, the sparser the arrangement, the cleaner the washing. Buy large sets rather than small ones; 4. There are few bowls that can be washed separately, so there is no need to stock up on several meals before washing; 5. My house has been in for several years. The height is more suitable for my cabinet. It is not as thick as the independent width. The original 3 drawers have been removed, and the cabinet next to it has been narrowed, and the countertop support has been made. There is no need to cut the quartz stone desktop. The modification is more successful and coordinated, and there is also a cabinet Edge banding, the material is not enough, the master will come to do it in a few days; the kitchen renovation cost is *, plus a tee and a water valve, the total is *, this one has * Yuan Jingdou kitchen renovation subsidy, which is equivalent to spending *, such a large project costs two 6. Haier has good after-sales service, with a 3-year warranty, and I also bought a 5-year extended warranty. In short, choose good after-sales, large number of sets, strong pressure, partition washing within the budget range, and save electricity to clarify the direction. It is best to ask Haier after-sales to measure the size before buying.
Comments (Original): 纠结了至少5年终于入手，还在观望的早点买，早买早享受，我选这款的几个原因：1、开门烘干，省电时间短而且透气，只要不选择快洗，基本自动开门就干了以前家里没有洗碗机，我也是要打开柜子透气的；2、水压大，普通的碗水压一般就够了，但是洗烤盘洗燃气灶架子洗油烟机滤网，必须要压强大水温高才能冲洗掉，在预算范围内买水压最大的那款；3、套数大可以多放几个锅，还能洗砧板菜篮高压锅，我家高压锅洗的跟新的一样，我们一家三口人吃饭，摆的越稀疏洗的越干净，套数买大不买小；4、碗少还能分区洗，没必要囤几顿再洗；5、我家已经入住几年了，这款深度高度更匹配我的柜子，没有独立宽那么厚，去掉了原来的3个抽屉，旁边的柜子改窄了，还做了台面支撑，不用切割石英石桌面，改的比较成功协调，还有个柜子封边，材料不够师傅过几天上门弄；厨改费用*，加一个三通还有水阀一共*，这款有*元京豆厨改补贴，相当于花了*，这么大的工程两个师傅弄了一下午，很划算了；6、海尔售后好，有3年保修，我还买了5年延保。总之在预算范围内选售后好、套数大、压强大、分区洗，省电就可以明确方向了，最好在购买之前让海尔售后上门量一下尺寸
